content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 8(d) (p0054) is a material IP deviation — it grants TrueLink a worldwide licence to "distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit" our borrower Credit Data, i.e. independent exploitation of Customer Data, which is walk-away territory under the IP rule. The Agreement also has no ownership/assignment of work product created for us, no retained-rights statement for Client Content/Credit Data, and no no-joint-ownership term; Section 10 only treats Support Services results as confidential, which is not an ownership cure.

**Proposal (preferred level, two surgical ops):**
1. Narrow the Credit Data licence in place to "process, upload, display, copy and store ... solely to provide the Hosting and Support Services to Client", keeping the Non-Competition Agreement limitation verbatim.
2. Insert a new § 2(e) after the existing Ownership clause: Client ownership plus TrueLink assignment of deliverables/work product, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP, Client retention of all rights in its content, IP and Credit Data, and no joint ownership.

TrueLink's retention of its Interface IP (§ 2(d)) is beneficial-neutral and preserved as already meeting the pre-existing IP element.
